summary: Tested newly added Quick Wins features (Rolling Returns, XIRR, Category Pie Chart, transactions/buy-more). All 10 new backend tests + 14 existing regression tests PASSED (24/24). Frontend visual verification confirmed: Rolling Returns 6-cell card (with CAGR labels on 3Y/5Y), XIRR pill on hero card (+32.74%), XIRR badges on each holding card, donut PieChart with legend showing category + amount + percent. Dark mode renders correctly on portfolio screen after toggle. Regression: dashboard, watchlist, settings, fund detail still render. Backend logs clean, no 500s.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' appears multiple times. Likely from a library or app component still passing pointerEvents prop instead of via style. Non-blocking but should be fixed.

action_items: (Optional) Persist theme selection to AsyncStorage. Currently on Expo web, navigating to a new route via direct URL load resets theme to light because state lives only in React context. This is pre-existing (not caused by Quick Wins) but worth fixing for UX.
(Optional) Silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by migrating any usage to style.pointerEvents (search third-party or shared components).
critical_code_review_comments: XIRR Newton-Raphson implementation in server.py handles single-cashflow / all-negative cases by returning None — verified frontend renders gracefully (no crash, badge hidden) when xirr is null.
category_breakdown is sorted desc by value and pct sums to ~100% across multiple holdings — verified in test_multiple_categories_breakdown.
buy-more endpoint correctly recomputes weighted-average buy price ((10*100 + 10*200)/20 = 150) and appends a new transaction — verified via API.
Rolling returns endpoint returns floats for all 6 periods on a fund with sufficient history; absolute % for <=1Y and CAGR % for 3Y/5Y is displayed correctly (UI shows 'CAGR' label only on 3Y/5Y).
Invalid scheme_code on /returns returns 502 (upstream failure) — acceptable; consider mapping to 404 for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 holdings (UTI Nifty 50, HDFC Mid-Cap, Axis Small Cap) via API for visual testing; all cleaned up afterwards. Portfolio is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_quick_wins.py (new) and /app/backend/tests/test_mf_tracker_api.py (existing). Run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` from /app. Frontend testID selectors used: portfolio-summary, portfolio-xirr, portfolio-total-current, category-breakdown, holding-xirr-{id}, returns-card, return-{1M|3M|6M|1Y|3Y|5Y}. Theme toggle is at /settings via testid theme-dark / theme-light / theme-toggle.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Quick Wins implementation. Theme-not-persisting across hard navigations is pre-existing and out of scope.
